# Decision Index

Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). ADR-0001..0020 are the ratified Security Architecture Decisions (SAD) from [RFC-0002 Part 9](../rfcs/RFC-0002/part-09.md).

| [ADR-0001](../adr/ADR-0001.md) | Offline First | Accepted |

| [ADR-0003](../adr/ADR-0003.md) | Passkey First | Accepted |
| [ADR-0004](../adr/ADR-0004.md) | No Master Password | Accepted |
| [ADR-0005](../adr/ADR-0005.md) | Secure Enclave | Accepted |
| [ADR-0006](../adr/ADR-0006.md) | Separate Attachment Encryption | Accepted |

| [ADR-0009](../adr/ADR-0009.md) | Zero Plaintext Persistence | Accepted |
| [ADR-0010](../adr/ADR-0010.md) | Zero Proprietary Cryptography | Accepted |
